description: Set the merchant's OWN public wallet address to receive agent-paid USDC on Base (the x402 agent crypto rail). Provide ONLY the public receiving address (0x…, 42 chars) — NEVER a private key or seed phrase; gocushy stores just the address and never holds keys or funds. PAID-PLAN, and AGENT-ONLY: it's advertised solely to buyer AIs on the machine-readable offer contract (never on the human checkout), and only for offers where the merchant turned on agent crypto. Settlement is still rolling out (Base testnet first) — connecting a wallet now makes the offer discoverable as crypto-payable to agents.

wallet_address.description: Public Base/EVM receiving address (0x + 40 hex). NOT a private key or seed.
